summary: Tier-1 Damodaran integration as harness 3.3.0 (version-gated so stamped history stays green). Router adds the buyer question plus contingent_claim/asset_based primaries and a ref-recipe table Agent 5 must open; Agent 5 also gets a market-contest map and a hostile-review step. New 3.3.0 gates: narrative_bind life_cycle_stage/stage_fit + who_leads, buyer identity (numeric illiquidity_discount; total beta for private; ke_stepdown for vc_pe), market_contest, option_screens and distressed-call replaces DCF equity, a mandatory truncation assessment (p=0 + why_not_material, or p>0 weighted base), market-neutral wacc inputs (erp_method/beta_method not_applicable illegal while WACC applies; currency match), and per_share_bridge. Also fixed a pre-existing Windows-locale baseline break by normalizing un-encoded read_text() to UTF-8. A strategic-design-review reshape then made the new gates unbypassable, completed the ref-recipe table (one row per id) with a machine check that every ref path exists, and typed the new narrative_bind objects in the schema.
